# Sprint 42 triage, 2 November

Present: Marta (lead), Bob, Carol, Dave, Erin. Alice is on leave.

## Migrate CI to Qt 6.11
This did not finish in Sprint 41, so it moves to Sprint 42. Bob takes it over from Carol.
The work needs about one day. Later in the meeting Bob said that he is on the customer site all
sprint, so Dave takes it instead of Bob.

## The two PDF export crashes
The report on the empty table has the same stack trace as the older crash ticket. Keep the older ticket open. Close the newer ticket as a
duplicate, and say in a note on it which ticket it duplicates.

## Dark mode
Marta raised the priority to high, because of the customer demo. Somebody proposed to put it into Sprint 42 too.
Marta rejected that: the team has no capacity, so it stays without a milestone for now.

## CSV
Erin will add a CSV export for the report table in Sprint 42. No ticket exists for this yet, so create one. The title
must contain "CSV export", and it is a feature. The customer CSV import request is a different topic, and we did not discuss it.

## Flaky serial port test
Carol takes this one. High priority. It keeps its current labels.

## About dialog license notice
Dave finished this last week, and the ticket is still open. Close it.

## Legacy Qt5 build path
Short discussion, no decision. We talk about it again in Sprint 43.
